stage1.impression: A clean, competent interior render of a long, narrow bar. It reads as CG and not as a night photograph: the frame is exposed like a daytime showroom, the lit band under the ceiling reads as a pink-white lightbox (signage, not thick amber acrylic), the back bar is one bottle model cloned forty times, and the oak baffle and porch are lit flat with no pools. No EARF speaker is visible, so the frame has no hero, and the strongest colour is the oxblood banquette. As it stands a magazine would see a generic contemporary bar, not a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: Night exposure: frame lum_median 22-50 (now 69.1), with pools of light and darkness between them instead of an even wash
The lantern's band reads as thick amber cast acrylic with glowing fin edges and no clipping (now near-white pink, RGB 250/217/208, 3.7 % clipped, dE2000 27 against amber)
The lantern's oak baffle and porch read as real oiled oak lit by a graze, with falloff from top to bottom (now a flat 142-147 luminance over 80 % of the height)
The porch opening's inner face reads as sharp oak slats, not a soft, smeared stripe texture
The back bar holds varied bottles (shapes, heights, labels, fill levels), not copies of one model
Signs of life: a record out of its sleeve, glasses in use, a coat or bag on the banquette
Something specific to EARF is legible from this camera (a Core or Hemisphere in its tint, the lit band as the lantern's signature) so the bar is not generic
Materials at 1:1: honed terrazzo with a soft sheen picking up the pools; quartzite with veining; blackened steel with uneven patina

defects.what: Overexposed for a night interior: lum_median 69.1, lum_mean 80.6; reads as a lit showroom
Acrylic band reads as a pink-white lightbox: median 221.8, clip 3.72 %, RGB median 250/215/206, fins barely legible; signage, not premium acrylic
Diagonal bright streak on the ceiling just above the band, reads as a render artefact or stray specular
Oak baffle lit evenly (profile 145,143,147,143,142,134 then a drop): no graze, no pools, slats read as a printed stripe
Porch opening's inner face is a soft blurred stripe texture (median 120.6, range 101), reads as a curtain or a smeared texture, not oak
Back bar: one bottle model with one label repeated about 40 times; shelf lines clip (0.81 %)
Pendant shades glow cold white and their undersides clip; the only cool light in a 2700 K room
Terrazzo floor bright and uniform (median 99.6), chips read as noise at 1:1, no honed sheen or reflected pools
Bar top evenly lit (median 104.9), dark flat surface with no quartzite veining and no pools under the counter spots
Banquette leather is a flat, saturated oxblood, the most saturated colour in the frame; the leather has no creasing or sheen
Four identical tables in a row with near-identical glasses; empty, showroom-like
Ceiling track/rod line and pendant cords read as thin CG lines; ceiling is a flat dark plane

changes.problem: The frame is exposed like a day interior, so nothing reads as night and the room has no pools.

change.to: 2.6 (about one stop down); rebalance with c2-c4 so practicals stay bright

changes.expected: Frame median about 35-45, ceiling and corners dark but holding detail, the band, shelves and spots as the bright accents.

changes.problem: The lantern's band reads as a pink-white lightbox, so the acrylic looks like signage, not thick amber cast acrylic.

change.setting: the lantern's band: emission (and its colour)
change.to: 1.0, at about 2000-2200 K so it passes through the fins as amber; light the fins' polished edges brighter than their faces

changes.expected: A warm amber band in which each fin and its glowing edge is legible, no clipping, and a soft amber spill on the ceiling and baffle top.

changes.problem: The baffle is washed flat, so the oak slats read as a printed stripe and the lantern has no depth.

change.setting: the baffle's graze and the fill
change.to: graze as a narrow line from the band's foot raking down the slats (area 1.2 W/m2, 0.1 m deep, close to the face); fill 0.02 W/m2

changes.expected: The slats bright at the top and falling to about a third by the porch's head, shadows in the slot gaps, the oak grain readable.

changes.problem: The counter, floor and porch are lit evenly, with no pools of light and dark between them.

evidence.measured: bar top median 104.9; floor [300,640,860,800] median 99.6; porch [635,290,925,660] median 120.6 range 101

change.setting: the counter: 5 x spot; the banquette: 4 x spot; the route area
change.from: counter 14 W 26 deg; banquette 9 W 24 deg; route 0.3 W/m2
change.to: counter 14 W at 16 deg (tight pools on the quartzite); banquette 9 W at 16 deg aimed at the table tops; route 0.1 W/m2

changes.expected: Discrete pools on the bar top and each table, dark floor between them, the porch opening falling into shadow.

changes.problem: The back bar is one bottle model cloned about forty times, the clearest sign of a render.

evidence.measured: seen at 3x crop: identical shape and label in every slot; shelf-line clip 0.81 %

change.setting: back-bar props; the shelf and back-bar lines
change.to: 8-12 bottle models of varied height, glass and label, varied fill levels, gaps and a few glasses; lines 3.0

changes.expected: A back bar that reads as a real, used collection, small highlights on the glass, no clipping on the shelf lines.

changes.problem: The terrazzo floor reads as bright speckle noise with no honed sheen.

evidence.measured: median 99.6, p95 159.7; chips read as noise at 1:1

change.setting: terrazzo chip size, ground tone and finish
change.from: small, high-contrast chips on a light ground, matt
change.to: larger chips (8-15 mm) on a warm mid-grey ground, roughness about 0.35 so the pools and the band reflect softly

changes.expected: A floor that reads as honed stone at real scale, darker overall, with soft reflections of the spots and the band.

changes.problem: The room is empty and repetitive: four identical tables with near-identical glasses, no sign of life.

evidence.measured: seen: identical tables and glasses, nothing on the banquette or counter

change.to: a record out of its sleeve on the near table, two half-full glasses on the bar top in a pool, a coat or tote on the banquette, a menu card; vary glass types

changes.expected: The frame reads as a bar a moment after people stepped away, close and lived-in.

changes.problem: The pendant shades glow cold white and clip, the only cool light in a 2700 K room.

evidence.measured: seen: blue-white shades, undersides blown; whole-frame clip 0.24 % mostly here and on the band

change.setting: the pendants' lamp emission and colour temperature (shades as placed)
change.to: 2700 K, emission halved so the shade interior holds detail

changes.expected: Warm pendants that sit in the room's single colour temperature, bright but not blown.

out_of_scope.request: Put the EARF speaker (the Tropos pair in Ember) in view as the frame's hero and its one saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The pair is placed inside the lantern and this camera's job is the lantern's face from the shop table; showing it means a different frame, not a fix to this one

out_of_scope.request: Desaturate or change the banquette's oxblood leather, now the strongest colour in the frame
out_of_scope.why: The banquette's material is fixed by the card; only its light may change

out_of_scope.request: Make the porch's inner face read as sharp oak slats rather than a blurred stripe texture
out_of_scope.why: It looks like a texture or geometry fault in the model, not a light setting; check the asset before the next round

out_of_scope.request: Remove or soften the ceiling track and pendant cords
out_of_scope.why: Part of the architecture and products as placed
